title: Cool Breeze Citrus Lift

diffuser.notes: Add to a diffuser with water; run for 30–60 minutes for a refreshing burst.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; mist around the room, avoiding fabrics.

why_it_works: Sweet orange adds a cheerful, sun-kissed lift; peppermint cools and sharpens focus; lavender softens the blend, making it calming yet invigorating for hot days.
safety: Patch test before topical use; dilute properly.
Avoid eyes and mucous membranes; keep away from children and pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under medical care.
